That partnership ended in 2016, and the award reverted to the Ballon d'Or, while FIFA also reinstated its own separate annual award, [The Best FIFA Men's Player](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Best_FIFA_Men's_Player "The Best FIFA Men's Player") . In [2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Ballon_d'Or "2022 Ballon d'Or") , _France Football_ modified the rules for the Ballon d'Or. The timing was changed so that the award is based on a football season rather than a calendar year, and an international jury of specialized journalists—one representative per country from the top 100 in the latest [FIFA Men's World Ranking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIFA_Men's_World_Ranking "FIFA Men's World Ranking") —was introduced to determine the winner. [UEFA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA "UEFA") has co-organized the Ballon d'Or gala since [2024](https://en.wikipedia.
org/wiki/2024_Ballon_d'Or "2024 Ballon d'Or") , with _France Football_ retaining the voting system and the Ballon d'Or name.

[Lionel Messi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lionel_Messi "Lionel Messi") has won the Ballon d'Or a record eight times, followed by [Cristiano Ronaldo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cristiano_Ronaldo "Cristiano Ronaldo") with five. [Johan Cruyff](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johan_Cruyff "Johan Cruyff") , [Michel Platini](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michel_Platini "Michel Platini") and [Marco van Basten](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marco_van_Basten "Marco van Basten") have each won the award three times, while [Alfredo Di Stéfano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfredo_Di_Stéfano "Alfredo Di Stéfano") , [Franz Beckenbauer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Franz_Beckenbauer "Franz Beckenbauer") , [Kevin Keegan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kevin_Keegan "Kevin Keegan") , [Karl-Heinz Rummenigge](https://en.wikipedia.
org/wiki/Karl-Heinz_Rummenigge "Karl-Heinz Rummenigge") and [Ronaldo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronaldo_\(Brazilian_footballer\) "Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer)") have each won it twice. [Ousmane Dembélé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ousmane_Dembélé "Ousmane Dembélé") is the current holder of the award, having won [its 69th edition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Ballon_d'Or "2025 Ballon d'Or") in 2025.

# Ballon d'Or 2023: Who won the ballon d'Or?

* [Savya](https://factmandu.com/author/12)
* Oct 31, 2023

Share Tweet Pin

Messi

The 2023 Ballon d'Or award, presented by France Football magazine, celebrated the outstanding football talents of the 2022-23 season. The event was hosted by former Chelsea star Didier Drogba, who had previously presided over the last three Ballon d'Or galas, alongside French journalist Sandy Heribert. The accolades were based on performance during the season, encompassing the period from August 1, 2022, to July 31, 2023. This prestigious event took place on October 30, 2023.

## Who won the Ballon d'Or 2023?

On 30th October 2023, [**Lionel Messi**](https://factmandu.com/messi) won the 2023 men's Ballon d'Or. Messi wins his eighth Ballon d'Or award recognizing top soccer player of the year. Messi thanked his Argentina coach, teammates, and staff for making his victory possible.
"Tonight I'm enjoying myself. It's a pleasure that will never leave me, and I hope to be able to enjoy it for many years to come," Messi said through a translator. "Becoming world champion was the title we were missing. I'd like to thank everyone who helped make Argentina the world champion team."

"This title and this trophy," Messi said, "I share them with you and all our Argentina comrades." "I'm very happy with the decisions I've made and to be with Miami," Messi said. "I couldn't imagine having the career that I've had. Everything that I've achieved. The fortune I've had playing for the best team in the world, the best team in history. It's nice to win these individual trophies. To win the Copa America and then the World Cup, to get it done is amazing," Messi added.

[**Lionel Messi**](https://factmandu.
com/messi) has won eight Ballon d'Or. This latest addition to his remarkable trophy collection complements his previous victories in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019, and 2021, showcasing his exceptional and enduring excellence in the world of football.

Here is a compilation of the recipients of awards at the 2023 Ballon d'Or ceremony.

* Ballon d'Or - Lionel Messi (Inter Miami, Argentina)

  ## 1 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) ↔️

There will always be those who don't fully appreciate Harry Kane, but now that he has got the trophy monkey off his back that so many used to beat him with, the Bayern Munich striker has looked like a man on a mission, utterly determined to show that he is also worthy of individual recognition as he found the net at a remarkable rate.
